projectState.summary: Byte 13b-c2 is approved and merged. It defines the musical-event persistence shape without writing high-frequency events yet: `MusicalEvent` carries `gridPitch` from committed material and `performedPitch` from the sounded decision while preserving `pitch` as the performed-pitch compatibility field; `src/musical-event-record.ts` owns schema-v1 `MusicalEventRecordPayload` with `grid` and `performed` sections plus a fixed-capacity drop-oldest ring buffer. Claude confirmed the grid/performed schema is durable, the pitch alias is acceptable, and drop-oldest is fine if replay treats drops as discontinuities. Byte 13b-c3 should wire musical events into the buffer plus a separate batch flusher with no I/O/timers in Tone callbacks, failed drained batches routed to the retained/idempotent queue keyed by `sourceEventId`, and explicit stop cleanup behavior.
